description: Save the exact displayed Website Autopilot policy base: the approved enabled and policy_mode values, with the policy’s if_unchanged revision from soclo_page_autopilot (or expect_absent:true when none is saved). Needs the separate manage:autopilot permission. Free. Without confirm:true it returns a preview only; pass confirm:true only after the owner approves. A lost write reply must be reconciled with soclo_page_autopilot before retrying.

confirm.description: true only after the owner approved the exact change. Omit or pass false to get a preview: nothing is sent.

expect_absent.description: Only when soclo_page_autopilot reported no saved policy; otherwise pass the exact policy if_unchanged revision.

if_unchanged.description: Exact displayed site, page-list or History revision, as last read; never refresh it invisibly.

policy_mode.description: The Website Autopilot policy value to save: review (proposals wait for the owner) or hands_free.

name: soclo_page_autopilot_policy
title: Save the Website Autopilot policy
